text:
Priyanka Rao: Quick update for managers — final handbacks + manager forms due this Friday 11:59pm PST. New this cycle: review form v3 includes a `skip_level` checkbox and a short promotion packet link field. If you need an accommodation (LOA, travel, medical), reply or DM people-ops.

Marcus Bell: Question: what exactly toggles `skip_level`? Only for promotion candidates?

Priyanka Rao: Yes — tick `skip_level` when you want the skip-level reviewer to see the packet before calibration (promotion or edge performance cases). Otherwise leave unchecked.

Yuna Sato: Is there an API for bulk handback uploads? I automate team ops and want to push via script.

Priyanka Rao: Yup — there's an API endpoint (POST /hr/reviews/bulk_upload) and the UI CSV uploader. API accepts the same CSV columns shown below. Rate limit: 60 reqs/min.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: 72 hours left to submit manager reviews for 18 items in Priyanka's queue. :alarm_clock:  

Avery Holt: Can you paste the CSV header we should use? I saw a few variants floating around.

Priyanka Rao: Use this header exactly (ISO dates YYYY-MM-DD):
```
email,manager,handback_date,proxy,skip_level,confidential,preferred_slot,notes,promotion_packet_link
```
Example rows:
```
email,manager,handback_date,proxy,skip_level,confidential,preferred_slot,notes,promotion_packet_link
marie@redwood.com,marcus@redwood.com,2025-06-25,avery@redwood.com,yes,no,AM,"prorated goals","https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/packets/123"
jordan@redwood.com,marcus@redwood.com,2025-06-25,,no,yes,PM,"sensitive promotion case","https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/packets/124"
```

Marcus Bell: If `confidential` is `yes`, who sees the packet?

Priyanka Rao: Confident packets are redacted into a HR-only view by default; add a one-line reason in `notes` and people-ops will arrange a private calibration block with HR present.

Yuna Sato: For skip-level reviewers, do we still do the two-step handback? Trying to script the email reminders.

Priyanka Rao: Two-step flow remains for skip-levels: manager handback triggers skip-level notif, skip-level has 72h to confirm. If skip-level doesn't respond we escalate to the manager's lead. API returns `skip_level_status` so you can poll.

people-ops-bot: Note: bulk upload max 10k rows via API. UI max file size 8MB. Hit an error? Paste 5 lines here and well help. :mailbox_with_mail:  

Avery Holt: Can managers request AM/PM slot preferences in this CSV?

Priyanka Rao: Yes — `preferred_slot` should be `AM` or `PM`. We try to honor preferences but may shift for schedule constraints.

Marcus Bell: One more — calibration group size? Last cycle sessions ran long.

Priyanka Rao: Aim for 7-9 names per live calibration. If you have more, split into Group A / Group B and tag the file name `orgname-groupA` etc.

Yuna Sato: Is there any audit sampling this round? We need to know for records automation.

Priyanka Rao: Evals will sample ~5% of packets for quality checks (focusing on promotion/confidential cases). If flagged, people-ops will reach out for more evidence.

people-ops-bot: Heads-up: Final calibration calendar will be posted by EOD Thu. If you need a same-day exception for travel, notify people-ops before Thu noon. :calendar:  

Marcus Bell: Thanks — scheduling our CSV upload tonight.

Priyanka Rao: Thanks everyone. Ping me or people-ops@redwood.com for urgent exceptions or API access tokens. :wave:
